# FurrFinder (www.furrfinder.com)

## Purpose
FurrFinder is a free digital health record ("libretto sanitario digitale") for dogs and cats, for pet owners in Italy. It is connected to the owner's veterinary clinic: when the clinic uses Vetroom (vetroom.it, a free veterinary practice management software by the same company), visits, PDF reports, vaccinations and recall reminders reach the owner's phone automatically.

## What owners can do
- Keep a health record per animal: visits, PDF reports, vaccinations, weight, microchip
- Receive push reminders for vaccine recalls and check-ups set by the vet
- Request appointments in the clinic's free time slots and receive confirmation
- Message the clinic with photos and PDFs, with read receipts
- Find veterinary invoices year by year for the Italian tax return (730), with an estimate of the 19% deduction and the status of the transmission to the Sistema Tessera Sanitaria
- Share an animal only with chosen clinics and revoke access at any time
- Publish a free lost-pet alert (Lost & Found): public page with photo and approximate area, shareable poster with QR code, sightings from anyone with push notification to the owner
- Use it from the browser, installable on the phone home screen (no app store needed); Italian and English

## Key facts
- Free for owners; Vetroom is free for veterinarians
- Data stored on servers in the European Union (Frankfurt)
- Login with a Google account
- Operated by AF&B S.r.l.s., Via Mario Ugo Guattari 48, 00173 Roma, Italy, VAT IT13698751008

## Notes
Health guides are reviewed by Dr. Federica Dromi, veterinarian registered with the Ordine dei Medici Veterinari della Provincia di Roma (no. 2513): https://www.furrfinder.com/revisione-veterinaria.html
Content on this site is informative and does not replace a veterinary visit. Contact: info@vetroom.it
